elements.label: Mysterious documents
elements.description: A package of peculiar papers from my correspondent's executor. I must STUDY it, using either Health, Reason, Passion, or Funds.

slots.label: Approach
slots.description: Who am I? Will I use sensuality, discipline, passion, or money to get through this

elements.comments: similar to the bequest. Note that there are four study options. First three options are Health=Alpha Reason=Lambda Passion=Omega. If you choose funds you go down the evil path and it is quite different in gameplay.

elements.label: Retail Job
elements.description: A precarious position as a cart pusher. Miserable, but it's all you can find just now.

elements.label: Notes on a Possible Collaborator
elements.description: My correspondent had recorded his observations of me. He believed I had 'potential'. He recorded his observations of someone else, too. With time and study, perhaps I can find that person.
